heading.title: NOTICE OF OBLIGATION TO PAY IMPROVEMENT DISTRICT ASSESSMENT TO THE CITY OF SAN ANTONIO, TEXAS
heading.explanation: The document contains a clear standalone title at the top of the page indicating it is a notice regarding an obligation to pay an improvement district assessment to the City of San Antonio, Texas. The page is not blank or a confirmation page.
